title: EmployeeJobModel
description: An employee job record from the UCPath-backed Employment and Job Data API. Private.

employeeId.description: The 8-character employee number (treat this as a string)

jobCode.description: The unique job code that represents this job

hireDate.description: The hire date in YYYYMMDD format

terminationDate.description: The termination date in YYYYMMDD format

deptCode.description: The primary HR department associated with job.

fte.description: The percentage allocation of the employee to the job.
